title: Recorded change explanations
responsibility: Summarizes recorded reasons within writing limits while retaining full notes, attempts and outcomes.

inputs.name: reasonsTried.reasons
inputs.description: The EntityReasons summary of one history row, as entityReasons returns it; only its attempted list is read, and each attempt counts under every kind that one of its uses names. Attempts are not checked against any limit here, because writingLimits.attempt applies to the joined text that reasonsTried returns.

behavior.text: Joins the notes once each and cuts the text at a whole word. Groups texts that are equal after whitespace is collapsed.

simplification.text: Replaced the nested loop with one pass over the notes.

performance.text: Nothing applies: the notes are a short list. Used a Map so each lookup is constant time.

inputs.name: reasonUses.uses
inputs.description: The uses of one attempt, each a subject with its kind (simplification or performance) and its humanized outcome, as entityReasons records them in attempted. The subjects are grouped by kind and outcome in the order given, and nothing is deduplicated, so a subject listed twice appears twice in the output.

inputs.name: boundedText.notes
inputs.description: The notes to join: each is trimmed with its whitespace runs collapsed, empty ones are dropped, and a note that repeats an earlier one is kept once, in first-seen order. The joined text is then bounded by boundedText.limit, and no note is cut on its own.
examples: Joins the notes once each and cuts the text at a whole word.
Groups texts that are equal after whitespace is collapsed.
Keeps every  note  as written.
Keeps every note as written.
Joins the notes once each.
Replaced the nested loop with one pass over the notes, then checked each subject once and kept every outcome in order of first appearance.

inputs.name: boundedText.limit
inputs.description: The most characters the combined text may have, counted as Unicode code points, and the most whitespace-separated words it may have, where words null sets no word limit. writingLimits.behavior ({ words: 30, characters: 200 }) bounds behavior notes and writingLimits.attempt ({ words: 20, characters: 140 }) bounds attempts.

inputs.name: alike.said
inputs.description: Each reason text with the item it came from, such as a subject or a use. Entries whose text is empty once whitespace is collapsed are dropped, and texts that are equal after that collapse, compared case-sensitively, form one group that keeps the first text as written.

outputs.description: The notes joined with single spaces into one normalized text, and whether it was cut to fit the limit. A cut keeps the longest run of whole words that still fits with the ellipsis '…', which is added as its own word; when not even the first word fits that way, the first limit.characters minus one Unicode characters are kept and the ellipsis is added directly after them.
